feeds.title: Drought
feeds.description: Women with eczema and psoriasis have been ignored by the beauty industry for far too long. Drought was created to provide high quality natural products, that you won't be embarrassed to have on display in your bathroom.

feeds.title: International Psoriasis Council News
feeds.description: Psoriasis News brings you the latest in global psoriasis news and research from some of the top dermatologists and thought leaders. IPC harnesses the collective expertise of its 100+ physicians to educate other physicians on a range of topics related to psoriasis management. Courses are presented live via webinar or video on-demand. To reinforce its psoriasis curriculum, IPC publishes resources, tools, and information available at no cost to clinicians.

feeds.title: U.S. Dermatology Partners Blog » Psoriasis
feeds.description: U.S. Dermatology Partners is one of the largest dermatology practices in the country, caring for more than 1.5 million patients each year with nearly 90 locations across eight states including Arizona, Colorado, Kansas, Maryland, Missouri, Oklahoma, Texas, and Virginia. Explore the latest news and updates on Psoriasis, experts advice, diagnosis and more!

feeds.title: A Warrior Curing Psoriasis Naturally
feeds.description: This is the blog of a Warrior who is healing Psoriasis naturally through with home remedies. Here you can follow in my footsteps and get rid of Psoriasis

feeds.title: Alishagotplants Blog
feeds.description: Alisha is the creator and blogger for beingmeinmyownskin.com, a website dedicated to her experience with psoriasis, which has been recognized by Healthline.com as one of the top psoriasis blogs in the country.

feeds.title: FreedomFromPsoriasis.com Blog
feeds.description: Making Clear Skin Fun and Easier Than You Ever Thought Possible. Our mission is to create an inspiring, supportive and downright fun web-site that helps people suffering from psoriasis to effectively and cheaply maintain healthy, plaque-free skin.

feeds.title: newlifeoutlookPsoriasis
feeds.description: Whether you've just been diagnosed or have been living with Psoriasis for years, you'll find valuable resources and a supportive community at NewLifeOutlook.

feeds.title: It's Just A Bad Day, Not A Bad Life
feeds.description: I'm a certified holistic health coach & doterra wellness advocate, on living with avascular necrosis of the knee, psoriatic arthritis and complex regional pain syndrome.

feeds.title: Overcoming Psoriasis
feeds.description: Todd Bello was diagnosed with psoriasis at age 28. He started his blog as a way to help other people learn about this skin disease. To raise awareness and offer support, he also started a support group called Overcoming Psoriasis to help those with psoriasis and their families receive the accurate information they need to manage the condition.

feeds.title: My Skin and I
feeds.description: This is a blog devoted to my skin condition, Psoriasis. I will be writing about my experiences, feelings and generally how I cope with Psoriasis. I hope others will join me in sharing their experiences and helping others learn how to get through this.

feeds.title: PsoHoward
feeds.description: This blog can be a tool to contribute in a small way to the need to connect and communicate about that part of our lives that so often stays under wraps: psoriasis.

feeds.title: The Flaky Fashionista
feeds.description: Fashion tips for psoriasis sufferers - a blog that helps you to be stylish and fabulous even on your flakiest days.

feeds.title: Just A Girl With Spots
feeds.description: oni Kazantzis was diagnosed with psoriasis at the age of 15. The disease made her self-conscious as a young person, but over time it also strengthened her and made her more confident. She uses her blog to empower and help others cope with the skin disorder. She offers stories about her personal experiences.

feeds.title: Dermasolve Psoriasis & Eczema Treatment Blog
feeds.description: Doctor-Recommended Dermasolve is a complete line of products for both the body and scalp. This new treatment combines FDA-recognized ingredients together with Ovasome Technology. Dermasolve is scientifically formulated to treat the symptoms of psoriasis, eczema, seborrheic dermatitis, scalp psoriasis and dandruff. This blog features news, product updates and articles pertaining to the treatment of psoriasis and the cure of psoriasis.

feeds.title: Hanna Sillitoe Blog
feeds.description: Find out more about the underlying triggers causing your skin to flare. I am Hannah. I suffered from Psoriasis at the age of 15. After lots of medications and drugs, I went back to repairing my gut health. This blog is a way of sharing all the healthy diets and recipes to battle Psoriasis.

feeds.title: So Sona Skincare Blog
feeds.description: Follow our journal and read our blogs on real skincare issues. We discuss tips and tricks on caring for psoriasis, eczema and other skincare issues. Endless amounts of experimentation with skincare led Sona to establish a brand that not only reflected her personal journey with psoriasis but also the creation of an all-natural formula. Sona finally found her winning recipe, however, she wanted to share this with others to help them feel confident and be true to their skin.

feeds.title: PsoriaCare
feeds.description: The PsoriaCare line of products clears the visible symptoms of psoriasis, eczema, and dermatitis. They produce dramatic results in just 48 hours. PsoriaCare's Living with Psoriasis blog offers tips and tricks to make living with psoriasis easier and more manageable.

feeds.title: The Natural Psoriasis Treatment Program Blog
feeds.description: Naturopathic Physician Eric Bakker is a psoriasis expert and the author of the Psoriasis Program. He writes regular posts on the causes, symptoms and treatment of psoriasis, and has helped thousands of psoriasis sufferers recover from their condition.

feeds.title: Psoriasis psucks!
feeds.description: I'm Sarah. I live in Minneapolis, MN. This is my regular tumblr. I hope we can all make a space together for kvetching, commiserating, and informing each other about the disease we all have in common (and its specific variations, too) in order to make living with it just a little bit easier.

feeds.title: Sabrina Skiles
feeds.description: Sabrina Skiles is a lifestyle resource for millennial women and those living with chronic conditions. She shares daily inspiration from health and wellness, motherhood and marriage to managing a chronic disease while living a stylish life.
